units.source_text: 有一天晚上，二姐節子和大姐一起來我的房間玩，讓我做了許多搞笑表演後，提出了這樣的要求。

en.t: One evening, my second sister Setsuko came to my room with my elder sister, and after making me perform all sorts of comic acts, they made this request.

units.source_text: 「別問這麼多，先戴上眼鏡，借戴一下大姐的眼鏡！」

en.t: Never mind why. Just put on the glasses first, borrow our elder sister's glasses and put them on!

units.source_text: 她總是用蠻橫的語氣跟我說話。

en.t: She always spoke to me in that high-handed tone.

units.source_text: 於是，搞笑的我只好乖乖地戴上大姐的眼鏡。

en.t: So I, the clown, obediently put on my elder sister's glasses.

units.source_text: 那一刻，她們倆笑得前俯後仰。

en.t: At that moment, the two of them doubled over with laughter.

units.source_text: 「太像了！簡直跟勞埃德一模一樣！」

en.t: It is uncanny! You look exactly like Lloyd!

units.source_text: 當時，哈羅德·勞埃德這位外國喜劇電影演員在日本正博得人氣。

en.t: At the time, the foreign comic film actor Harold Lloyd was gaining popularity in Japan.

units.source_text: 我站起來舉起一隻手：「諸位，這次我要為日本的影迷們……」

en.t: I stood up, raised one hand, and said, Ladies and gentlemen, this time, for the movie fans of Japan...

units.source_text: 我試著說開場白，更是讓她們大笑不止。

en.t: When I tried giving that opening speech, it only made them laugh even harder.
